description: Linked data UI toolkit for Preact.

scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces && npm --prefix specimen run clean && ush rm dist docs node_modules
scripts.setup: npm ci && ush ln && npm --prefix specimen run setup
scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces && ush rm docs && npx typedoc
scripts.proof: npm run build && npx wds --root-dir docs --open
